scripts.build: npm run build -w @vct/shared-types && npm run build -w @vct/poker-engine && npm run build -w @vct/blackjack-engine && npm run build -w @vct/game-server && npm run build -w @vct/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @vct/game-server" "npm run dev -w @vct/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @vct/shared-types && npm run build -w @vct/poker-engine && npm run build -w @vct/blackjack-engine && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
